subject: Brief 15m deep-dive invite — BrightMode trial usage
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@brightmode.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Quick 15m deep-dive? Noticed BrightMode trial spike

Hi Alex,

I’m Stephanie on the SDR team at Redwood Inference — congrats on getting BrightMode set up. I noticed a sudden uplift in token usage from your trial project (roughly 6.2M tokens yesterday, ~3x your baseline) and wanted to offer a quick 15-minute deep-dive to make sure you’re getting predictable latency/cost, and to show a couple of small config knobs that often cut unit cost without changing results.

Would you be open to a short session tomorrow or Friday? Quick options below (PDT):
- Thu Sep 3: 10:30–10:45 or 15:00–15:15
- Fri Sep 4: 09:00–09:15 or 16:00–16:15

I attached a small usage export so you can see the burst pattern. No sales pitch — just practical tuning + a checklist you can apply in 15 minutes. If none of those work, share a couple times that do and we’ll make it happen.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
SDR, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: brightmode_usage_report.csv (CSV, 14KB)
From: Alex Morgan <alex@brightmode.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T15:08:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick 15m deep-dive? Noticed BrightMode trial spike

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the heads up and the data. That spike was unexpected; we started a new batch job overnight. I can do a 15-minute slot on Friday at 09:00 PDT.

Couple quick asks:
- Can the session cover recommendations for batching/kv-cache to reduce token churn?
- Also curious about any quick guardrails we should set to avoid surprises in billing.

See you Friday.

Alex
Head of Platform, BrightMode
alex@brightmode.ai

Hey Alex — Ben from Product Ops here, stepping in to get this on the calendar and share a lightweight agenda. Stephanie flagged the pattern to me and I can cover the quick guardrails.

Proposed 15-minute agenda (to keep it focused):
1) Confirm what triggered the batch (30–60s)
2) 3 rapid config levers (batching, prefix cache, short quantization tips) (6–7 min)
3) Billing guardrails + cost estimate for the current run rate (3–4 min)

I just sent a calendar invite for Fri Sep 4, 09:00–09:15 PDT — includes a join link and an attached .ics. If that conflicts, here are two alternate slots (same link):
- Fri Sep 4, 16:00–16:15 PDT
- Thu Sep 3, 15:00–15:15 PDT

Link: https://cal.redwood.com/stephanie/15m
Invite: demo-15min-invite.ics (calendar invite)

See you then — we’ll keep it short and actionable.

Ben Carter
Product Operations, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0188
From: Alex Morgan <alex@brightmode.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:21:07-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick 15m deep-dive? Noticed BrightMode trial spike

Confirmed, Fri 09:00 works — accepted the invite.

Small request for the call: could you include a one-slide summary of the recommended config changes and a short note on any effects on latency so I can share with engineering? Also, how do you handle SOC2 / data retention questions for trial logs — we need to confirm before we run a follow-on batch.

Thanks, looking forward to it.

—Alex
